description: Postal areas most like a given one across its whole statistical profile — income, age structure, education, housing and employment together, not one metric. Useful for "where else in Finland feels like this neighbourhood?". Similarity is statistical, not geographic: the results are usually spread across the country. An area whose statistics are suppressed shares too few dimensions to be compared and is left out, so absence from the list is not dissimilarity — it is unmeasured.

place.description: Postal area name or 5-digit code, e.g. "Hervanta", "00530".

name: find_similar_areas
title: Find statistically similar Finnish areas
